verdict.rationale: Rive has automatic revision history with non-destructive restore to previous versions, giving basic version/rollback capability, but this applies to design file saves, not to 'automations' (e.g., AI agent/MCP-driven workflows) themselves, and there's no evidence of reviewing diffs, branching, or rolling back specific AI-agent actions or scripted automations. missing for 10: version control/diffing for AI-agent-generated changes (MCP/CLI actions), review workflow for automation changes, granular rollback of specific automation steps rather than whole-file history.
